items.source: In order to resolve ${...} placeholders in <bean> definitions or @Value annotations using properties from a PropertySource, you must ensure that an appropriate embedded value resolver is registered in the BeanFactory used by the ApplicationContext. This happens automatically when using <context:property-placeholder> in XML. When using @Configuration classes this can be achieved by explicitly registering a PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer via a static @Bean method. Note, however, that explicit registration of a PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer via a static @Bean method is typically only required if you need to customize configuration such as the placeholder syntax, etc. See the "Working with externalized values" section of @Configuration's javadocs and "a note on BeanFactoryPostProcessor-returning @Bean methods" of @Bean's javadocs for details and examples.
items.translation: 为了解决 `` 定义或 `@Value` 注解中的 `${...}` 占位符，并使用来自 `PropertySource` 的属性，您必须确保在 `ApplicationContext` 使用的 `BeanFactory` 中注册了适当的嵌入式值解析器（embedded value resolver）。在使用 XML 中的 `` 时，此操作会自动完成。当使用 `@Configuration` 类时，可以通过静态的 `@Bean` 方法显式注册 `PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer` 来实现。然而请注意，通过静态 `@Bean` 方法显式注册 `PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer` 通常仅在您需要自定义配置（例如占位符语法等）时才需要。有关详细信息和示例，请参阅 `@Configuration` 的 javadoc 中的“Working with externalized values"部分，以及 `@Bean` 的 javadoc 中的"a note on BeanFactoryPostProcessor-returning @Bean methods"部分。

items.source: In certain situations, it may not be possible or practical to tightly control property source ordering when using @PropertySource annotations. For example, if the @Configuration classes above were registered via component-scanning, the ordering is difficult to predict. In such cases — and if overriding is important — it is recommended that the user fall back to using the programmatic PropertySource API. See ConfigurableEnvironment and MutablePropertySources javadocs for details.
items.translation: 在某些情况下，使用 `@PropertySource` 注解时可能无法或难以严格控制属性源顺序。例如，如果上述 `@Configuration` 类是通过组件扫描注册的，则其顺序难以预测。在这种情况下——如果覆盖很重要——建议用户回退到使用程序化的 `PropertySource` API。有关详细信息，请参阅 ConfigurableEnvironment 和 MutablePropertySources 的 JavaDoc。

items.source: @PropertySource can be used as a repeatable annotation. @PropertySource may also be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: @PropertySource 可用作一个 可重复 注解。@PropertySource 也可用作 元注解 来创建具有属性覆盖的自定义 组合注解。

items.source: Assuming that "my.placeholder" is present in one of the property sources already registered — for example, system properties or environment variables — the placeholder will be resolved to the corresponding value. If not, then "default/path" will be used as a default. Expressing a default value (delimited by colon ":") is optional. If no default is specified and a property cannot be resolved, an IllegalArgumentException will be thrown.
items.translation: 假设"my.placeholder"已存在于某个已注册的属性源中（例如系统属性或环境变量），则该占位符将被解析为相应的值。否则，将使用"default/path"作为默认值。指定默认值（由冒号":"分隔）是可选的。如果未指定默认值且无法解析属性，将抛出IllegalArgumentException。

items.source: In cases where a given property key exists in more than one property resource file, the last @PropertySource annotation processed will 'win' and override any previous key with the same name.
items.translation: 在给定属性键存在于多个属性资源文件的情况下，最后处理的 `@PropertySource` 注解将“胜出”并覆盖任何具有相同名称的先前键。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, resource location wildcards are also supported — for example, "classpath*:/config/*.properties".
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，也支持资源位置通配符——例如 `"classpath*:/config/*.properties"`。

items.source: Each location will be added to the enclosing Environment as its own property source, and in the order declared (or in the order in which resource locations are resolved when location wildcards are used).
items.translation: 每个位置都将被作为其自身的属性源添加到包围的 `Environment` 中，顺序为声明的顺序（或者在使用位置通配符时解析资源位置的顺序）。
